Harrowgate provided the change of control notice that the MSA requires. The notice was given on 3 September 2026, as stated in the source [3]. The notice was provided to the General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB, as required by Clause 14.2 of the MSA [1].

The notice was given 30 days before the expected completion of the change of control, which was scheduled for 15 October 2026. This is confirmed by the source [3], which shows that the notice was given 30 days in advance, as required by the MSA.

evidence.quote: Date: 3 September 2026
Provider shall provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client in accordance with Clause 22.
Completion is expected on 15 October 2026

items.question: What service credit applies to downtime, and what monthly fee is it calculated on?
items.answer:
The service credit applicable to downtime is 5% of the monthly subscription fee for each full hour of unavailability [1]. This service credit is calculated on the monthly subscription fee, which is USD 18,500 [4].

The service credit is capped at 25% of the monthly subscription fee [1].

Therefore, the service credit is calculated as 5% of the monthly subscription fee, which is USD 18,500.

evidence.quote: For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee.
Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform.
Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.

items.question: What is the monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer: The monthly storage fee under the Kestrel storage agreement is EUR 4,600. This is stated in the amendment to the agreement, which replaces the original monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 [2]. The amendment was signed on 20 May 2026 and took effect on 1 June 2026.

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The Kestrel Storage Services Agreement specifies the notice period required to terminate the agreement. According to the agreement, either party may terminate the Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice [1].

There is no conflicting information in the sources about the notice period for termination of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement. The documents do not indicate any changes to this term.

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller alarm sounded?
items.answer: According to the documents, Jonas Ekberg stated that the chiller alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. This is stated [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026.

items.question: What did the shift supervisor say about the Voss-Lindqvist pallets?
items.answer: The shift supervisor, Jonas Ekberg, stated that the Voss-Lindqvist pallets were moved to Hall 1 by 05:15 on the morning of the chiller failure [1]. He also mentioned that he did not speak to anyone at Voss-Lindqvist AB about the failure until the following day [1].

evidence.quote: I remember that we had moved the Voss-Lindqvist pallets to Hall 1 by 05:15 that morning, before the day shift arrived.
I did not speak to anyone at Voss-Lindqvist AB about the failure until the following day.

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller was repaired?
items.answer: The documents do not specify when Jonas Ekberg said the chiller was repaired. The source only mentions that he moved the Voss-Lindqvist pallets to Hall 1 by 05:15 on the morning after the chiller failure, but it does not state when the chiller itself was repaired [1].
